# Auto Mobile Glass

Auto Mobile Glass is a family-owned mobile auto-glass business with more than 20 years of experience. It serves Northland from Unit 3/17 Gumdigger Place, Raumanga, Whangārei 0110 and a second location inside Marsden Auto Centre at 470 Marsden Point Road, Ruakākā 0171.

Services include windscreen replacement, chip and crack repair, side and rear glass, ADAS camera calibration, mobile service, insurance claims and Work and Income quotes.

Phone: 0800 367 264
Email: contact@automobileglass.co.nz
Service area: Whangārei, Ruakākā, Waipū, Mangawhai, Dargaville, Kerikeri, Kaikohe and rural Northland.
